title: In Silico Characterization of CXCL13+ Exhausted CD8+ T Cells in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
snippet: As a leading cause of cancer mortality, non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains a major clinical challenge. snippet: Methotrexate (MTX) remains a cornerstone therapy in oncology and, to a lesser extent, rheumatoid arthritis (RA), yet its clinical utility in both settings is constrained by dose-limiting toxicities, interpatient pharmacokinetic variability, and the development of therapeutic resistance.
